plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 4th house: they bring structure and seriousness to home and family - stability, or heaviness and obligation. Failure mode: home starts to feel like duty, or they control the domestic terms. Build the secure base; don't carry it as a weight alone.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
